questions.stem: You are asked to construct a triangle with sides $5\text{ cm}$, $7\text{ cm}$, and $9\text{ cm}$. After drawing the base of $9\text{ cm}$, what compass width should you use from one end?

options.text: $5\text{ cm}$ or $7\text{ cm}$ (one from each end)

questions.explanation: Set the compass to $5\text{ cm}$ and draw an arc from one end, then set it to $7\text{ cm}$ and draw an arc from the other end (or vice versa). The intersection of the arcs gives the third vertex.
